notes: v1.25.0: Other AI apps can now reach the part of your notes that matters. Connect Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code with a setup card made for each one, and a connected app can see the people, companies and projects behind your @mentions — with their details and how they connect — plus your reference library, your highlights and your folders. Your notebooks show up in the other app's attachment picker, four ready-made prompts come with them, and connected apps are told when your vault changes. It stays under your control: one Never / Ask first / Allow switch, a per-tool list, and every call recorded in Activity. Entity cards show their dates again, and Home greets you with a tip.
